transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Lucy. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Lucy, I am absolutely furious. I just saw my latest bill and there is a charge I don't recognize. This is ridiculous!
Agent: I am very sorry to hear that you are upset, and I understand how frustrating it is to see an unexpected charge on your statement.
Agent: Before we look into the account details, could you please provide your account number?
Customer: Yes, it is 72778440. My name is Anjali Johnson.
Agent: Thank you, Ms. Johnson. Just to confirm, could you please provide your phone number and email address for the record?
Customer: My phone is 92473 76007 and my email is anjali.22@examplemail.com.
Agent: Thank you. I have accessed your account. I see the charge you are referring to. It looks like a system error occurred during the last billing cycle.
Agent: I can assure you there won't be any more outages in your area.
Customer: I don't know why you're mentioning outages, but I just want this charge removed.
Agent: Of course. I will raise a refund request for the wrong charge right now.
Customer: Thank you, I appreciate you fixing this so quickly. I feel much better now.
Agent: You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? I have submitted the request, and you will see the credit on your next statement. Goodbye!
